name: Ore no Mono ni Nare! (Naranai)
original_name: 俺のものになれッ！(ならない)
source:
[Synopsis]
Katsuo, an immensely wealthy man, is head over heels for Zettai Makenashi. Determined to make him his own, he pulls out all the stops—resorting to everything from underground auctions to duels—in his quest to win him over.

[Translated from [url=https://x.com/marutoku_ktgi/status/2086668228919726314?s=61]xeet[/url]]
translation:
【剧情简介】
富可敌国的大富豪胜男对绝对负无一见倾心、迷恋不已。为了将对方占为己有，他不惜使出浑身解数——从地下拍卖会到正面决斗无所不用其极，势要赢取心上人的芳心。

[译自[url=https://x.com/marutoku_ktgi/status/2086668228919726314?s=61]X[/url]]
